comparison.objective: Remove a flush glass pane using two suction lifters and place it on bearers.
comparison.physical_skill: Position and lock two suction tools, coordinate a level bimanual lift, then unlock them after placement.
comparison.success_condition: Pane lifted with both lifters, laid flat on bearers, lifters unlocked, hands clear, and no drop, excessive tilt, or direct gripper contact.
comparison.reason: Tests attachment-tool setup, cooperative fragile-sheet transport, and release, not rotary adjustment with locknut countertorque and retained-cycle verification.
